source.other: On the good way

target.other: På den goda vägen

key: On the good way

source.other: Defeat the Armies of Hjalmar

target.other: Besegra Hjalmars arméer

key: Defeat the Armies of Hjalmar

source.other: From the North we are endangered by a belligerent tribe, led by warlord Törver, that is rapidly building up its armies. They may soon have become too strong to be defeated.

target.other: Norrifrån hotas vi av en krigförande stam som leds av krigsherren Törver och som snabbt bygger upp sina arméer. De kan snart vara för starka för att kunna besegras.

key: From the North we are endangered by a belligerent tribe, led by warlord Törver, that is rapidly building up its armies. They may soon have become too strong to be defeated.

source.other: Sire, we have defeated the pirates. They have hidden some gold in their last bastion which is now being transferred to our headquarters.

target.other: Ers höghet, vi har besegrat piraterna. De har gömt guld i sin sista fästning vilket nu transporteras till våra högkvarter.

key: Sire, we have defeated the pirates. They have hidden some gold in their last bastion which is now being transferred to our headquarters.

source.other: He noticed that we can also move along the other side of the mountain, in case we might fail here, but it will be much more difficult to do.

target.other: Han lade också märke till att vi kan ta oss fram längs bergets andra sida om vi skulle misslyckas här, men det blir mycket svårare.

key: He noticed that we can also move along the other side of the mountain, in case we might fail here, but it will be much more difficult to do.

source.other: Your name will be remembered forever.

target.other: Ditt namn kommer finnas i folkets minne i all framtid.

key: Your name will be remembered forever.

source.other: Sire, the battle with Törver progresses gloriously and we have already beaten the strongest part of his army. But this enemy will not be defeated easily. In a desperate move Törver has called in a group of hardened mercenaries.

target.other: Ers höghet, striden mot Törver utvecklas väl och vi har redan besegrat den starkaste delen av hans armé. Men fienden blir inte lätt att besegra. I desperation har Törver kallat in en grupp härdade legoknektar.

key: Sire, the battle with Törver progresses gloriously and we have already beaten the strongest part of his army. But this enemy will not be defeated easily. In a desperate move Törver has called in a group of hardened mercenaries.

source.other: Pirates on the run

target.other: Pirater på flykt

key: Pirates on the run

source.other: Sire, the wet season has created swamps along the brook to the East and we are unable to pass through them. They have to be removed before we can continue. If you bring enough shovels to the new warehouse then volunteers will remove the swamps.

target.other: Ers höghet, det blöta vädret har skapat träsk längs med bäcken i öster och vi kan inte komma över dem. De måste tas bort innan vi kan fortsätta. Om du får hit nog med spadar till den nya lagerbyggnaden kommer volontärer att dika ur träsken.

key: Sire, the wet season has created swamps along the brook to the East and we are unable to pass through them. They have to be removed before we can continue. If you bring enough shovels to the new warehouse then volunteers will remove the swamps.

source.other: Sire, after long study and research our wise men have finally managed to decipher the strange language in Törver’s descriptions that we had found in his headquarters. From now on we are able to build shipyards.

target.other: Ers höghet, efter långa studier och mycket forskande har våra vise män äntligen lyckats tyda det främmande språket i beskrivningarna vi fann i Törvers högkvarter. Från och med nu kan vi bygga skeppsvarv.

key: Sire, after long study and research our wise men have finally managed to decipher the strange language in Törver’s descriptions that we had found in his headquarters. From now on we are able to build shipyards.

source.other: We should build a port in Törver’s former land to be ready to send an expedition as soon as we found out how to build ships.

target.other: Vi borde bygga en hamn i Törvers forna land för att vara redo att skicka en expedition så snart vi kommer på hur man bygger skepp.

key: We should build a port in Törver’s former land to be ready to send an expedition as soon as we found out how to build ships.

source.other: They will be handed out to some volunteers for drying up the swamps.

target.other: De kommer att lämnas ut till volontärer för att torrlägga träsken.

key: They will be handed out to some volunteers for drying up the swamps.

source.other: Free our scout from the pirates

target.other: Befria vår spanare från piraterna

key: Free our scout from the pirates

source.other: Sire, we received an alarming message from one of our explorers. Törver is expanding his front line and approaching our territory.

target.other: Ers höghet, vi har fått ett oroande meddelande från en av våra upptäcktsresande. Törver flyttar fram sin front och närmar sig vårt territorium.

key: Sire, we received an alarming message from one of our explorers. Törver is expanding his front line and approaching our territory.

source.other: You have completed all goals and defeated all our enemies. You have not only conquered our rivalling tribes, but you have also captured the hearts of your loving people.

target.other: Du har klarat alla mål och besegrat alla våra fiender. Du har inte bara erövrat de rivaliserande stammarna, utan också vunnit ditt folks hjärtan.

key: You have completed all goals and defeated all our enemies. You have not only conquered our rivalling tribes, but you have also captured the hearts of your loving people.

source.other: Sire, my congratulations!

target.other: Ers höghet, jag får gratulera!

key: Sire, my congratulations!

source.other: Four more shovels for removing the swamps have been collected at the warehouse.

target.other: Ytterligare fyra spadar för att ta bort träsken har samlats ihop i lagerbyggnaden.

key: Four more shovels for removing the swamps have been collected at the warehouse.

source.one: %1% unit of %2% has been brought to your ‘%3%’ building.
source.other: %1% units of %2% have been brought to your ‘%3%’ building.

target.one: %1% enhet av %2% har transporterats till byggnaden ”%3%”.
target.other: %1% enheter av %2% har transporterats till byggnaden ”%3%”.

key: %1% unit of %2% has been brought to your ‘%3%’ building.:%1% units of %2% have been brought to your ‘%3%’ building.

source.other: Sire, now that we have conquered the land of Törver, we can make use of their excellent access to the adjacent great lake. A port in the North will give us better opportunities to have contact with other tribes.

target.other: Ers höghet, nu när vi har erövrat Törvers land kan vi dra nytta av deras goda tillgång till den stora sjön intill. En hamn i norr ger oss bättre möjligheter att få kontakt med andra stammar.

key: Sire, now that we have conquered the land of Törver, we can make use of their excellent access to the adjacent great lake. A port in the North will give us better opportunities to have contact with other tribes.

source.other: They will be handed out to additional volunteers for drying up the swamps.

target.other: De kommer att lämnas ut till ytterligare volontärer för att torrlägga träsken.

key: They will be handed out to additional volunteers for drying up the swamps.

source.other: Hjalmar is the enemy north of the former pirates, who is fighting under the green banner.

target.other: Hjalmar är fienden norr om de forna piraterna, som strider under den gröna fanan.

key: Hjalmar is the enemy north of the former pirates, who is fighting under the green banner.

source.other: Sire, our scout has returned to our territory, and he has shown us the road through the swamps towards Hjalmar.

target.other: Ers höghet, vår spanare har återvänt till vårt territorium och han har visat oss vägen genom träsken till Hjalmar.

key: Sire, our scout has returned to our territory, and he has shown us the road through the swamps towards Hjalmar.

source.other: Sire, our soldiers have conquered the island and managed to free the scout. It turns out that the pirates have left a large amount of gold, beer, and weapons on the island.

target.other: Ers höghet, våra soldater har erövrat ön och lyckats befria spanaren. Det visar sig att piraterna har lämnat en stor mängd guld, öl och vapen på ön.

key: Sire, our soldiers have conquered the island and managed to free the scout. It turns out that the pirates have left a large amount of gold, beer, and weapons on the island.

source.other: Build a Port in the North

target.other: Bygg en hamn i norr

key: Build a Port in the North

source.other: Bring shovels

target.other: Transportera spadar

key: Bring shovels

source.other: Island conquered

target.other: Ön erövrad

key: Island conquered

source.other: Build a warehouse close to the conquered pirate sentry near the brook. We will need it as a basis for further exploration. Furthermore we could use it to store some gold that we will mine from the surrounding hills.

target.other: Bygg en lagerbyggnad nära den erövrade piratvaktposten vid bäcken. Vi kommer att behöva det för att ha en bas för vidare utforskning. Vi kan också använda det till att lagra guld som vi bryter i de omkringliggande kullarna.

key: Build a warehouse close to the conquered pirate sentry near the brook. We will need it as a basis for further exploration. Furthermore we could use it to store some gold that we will mine from the surrounding hills.

source.other: Searching for gold

target.other: Sökande efter guld

key: Searching for gold

source.other: Sire, our men have located an isolated enemy pirate sentry. The abandoned huts indicate that there is gold nearby.

target.other: Ers höghet, våra män har upptäckt en isolerad fientlig piratvaktpost. De övergivna hyddorna tyder på att det finns guld i närheten.

key: Sire, our men have located an isolated enemy pirate sentry. The abandoned huts indicate that there is gold nearby.

source.other: Defeat the Pirates

target.other: Besegra piraterna

key: Defeat the Pirates

source.other: Found a treasure

target.other: Hittade en skatt

key: Found a treasure

source.other: Sire, thanks to our successful efforts to drive out the pirates, lots of them have fled and moved away in small boats. It is unknown in which direction they have escaped.

target.other: Ers höghet, tack vare våra framgångsrika försök att driva ut piraterna har många av dem flytt i små båtar. Vi vet inte åt vilket håll de har gett sig av.

key: Sire, thanks to our successful efforts to drive out the pirates, lots of them have fled and moved away in small boats. It is unknown in which direction they have escaped.

source.other: Build a port

target.other: Bygg en hamn

key: Build a port

source.other: Sire, we have found 25 units of gold ore inside the pirate sentry. They may have been looted from the gold diggers’ huts nearby. This gold ore will be transported to our headquarters.

target.other: Ers höghet, vi har hittat 25 enheter guldmalm i piratvaktposten. Den kan ha plundrats från guldgrävarnas hyddor i närheten. Guldmalmen transporteras till vårt högkvarter.

key: Sire, we have found 25 units of gold ore inside the pirate sentry. They may have been looted from the gold diggers’ huts nearby. This gold ore will be transported to our headquarters.

source.other: Our scout has been captured

target.other: Vår spanare har blivit tillfångatagen

key: Our scout has been captured

source.other: Build warehouse

target.other: Bygg lagerbyggnad

key: Build warehouse

source.other: Be patient and recognize that a strong army is indispensable in this situation. Törver has a very bad reputation.

target.other: Var tålmodig och inse att en stark armé är oumbärlig i vår situation. Törver har ett väldigt dåligt rykte.

key: Be patient and recognize that a strong army is indispensable in this situation. Törver has a very bad reputation.

source.other: The pirates were defeated.

target.other: Piraterna besegrades.

key: The pirates were defeated.

source.other: Defeat Törver

target.other: Besegra Törver

key: Defeat Törver

source.other: Bring Four Shovels to the new Warehouse

target.other: Transportera fyra spadar till den nya lagerbyggnaden

key: Bring Four Shovels to the new Warehouse

source.other: Your Advisor

target.other: Din rådgivare

key: Your Advisor

source.other: The scout returns

target.other: Spanaren kommer tillbaka

key: The scout returns

source.other: Ability to build shipyards

target.other: Förmåga att bygga skeppsvarv

key: Ability to build shipyards

source.other: Make sure that our armies are at full strength and then act decisively.

target.other: Säkerställ att våra arméer är så starka de kan vara och agera utan minsta tvekan.

key: Make sure that our armies are at full strength and then act decisively.

source.other: Conquer the Pirate Sentry

target.other: Ta över piratvaktposten

key: Conquer the Pirate Sentry

source.other: Over the river lies the prosperous land of the mysterious king Runar. We have been in war with him before the pirates occupied the eastern area. His strength is based on his vast industry and large armies.

target.other: På andra sidan floden ligger den mysteriske kungen Runars frodiga land. Vi har varit i krig med honom sedan innan piraterna ockuperade det ostliga området. Hans styrka grundas i hans väldiga industri och stora arméer.

key: Over the river lies the prosperous land of the mysterious king Runar. We have been in war with him before the pirates occupied the eastern area. His strength is based on his vast industry and large armies.

source.other: Free our neighbourhood from the pirate menace. The pirates are fighting under the grey banner.

target.other: Befria vårt område från pirathotet. Piraterna strider under den grå fanan.

key: Free our neighbourhood from the pirate menace. The pirates are fighting under the grey banner.

source.other: Sire, now that we have access to the pirates’ hideout, we should conquer it and finish them off. Maybe there are even more treasures hidden in their territory.

target.other: Ers höghet, nu när vi har tillgång till piraternas gömställe borde vi ta över det och göra slut på dem. Det kanske finns fler skatter gömda i deras territorium.

key: Sire, now that we have access to the pirates’ hideout, we should conquer it and finish them off. Maybe there are even more treasures hidden in their territory.

source.other: Defeat the pirates

target.other: Besegra piraterna

key: Defeat the pirates

source.other: Pirates are regrouping

target.other: Piraterna omgrupperar

key: Pirates are regrouping

source.other: Shovels

target.other: Spadar

key: Shovels

source.other: Transport

target.other: Transport

key: Transport

source.other: Our northern enemy

target.other: Vår fiende i norr

key: Our northern enemy

source.other: Sire, although our soldiers would face any enemy without the slightest fear, our rival in the North is still stronger than all our armies combined. We should avoid a conflict until we are able to defeat them.

target.other: Ers höghet, våra soldater skulle möta vilken fiende som helst utan minsta fruktan, men vår motståndare i norr är fortfarande starkare än alla våra arméer tillsammans. Vi bör undvika strid tills vi kan besegra dem.

key: Sire, although our soldiers would face any enemy without the slightest fear, our rival in the North is still stronger than all our armies combined. We should avoid a conflict until we are able to defeat them.

source.other: Defeat the Armies of Törver

target.other: Besegra Törvers arméer

key: Defeat the Armies of Törver

source.other: Conquer the pirate sentry near the brook to the East. Hopefully we will find out what happened to the gold in this area.

target.other: Erövra piraternas vaktpost nära bäcken i öster. Förhoppningsvis kan vi komma på vad som hände med guldet i området.

key: Conquer the pirate sentry near the brook to the East. Hopefully we will find out what happened to the gold in this area.

source.other: Conquer the Stronghold on the Island

target.other: Erövra högborgen på ön

key: Conquer the Stronghold on the Island

source.other: Sire, as a result of our attacks on the pirates they have started to regroup with pirates from other tribes. They could regain much of their previously lost strength. Our dwindling resources can become a problem with such a mighty enemy in front of us.

target.other: Ers höghet, till följd av våra angrepp har piraterna börjat sluta sig samman med pirater från andra stammar. De kan återfå mycket av sin tidigare förlorade styrka. Våra sinande resurser kan bli ett problem med en så mäktig fiende framför oss.

key: Sire, as a result of our attacks on the pirates they have started to regroup with pirates from other tribes. They could regain much of their previously lost strength. Our dwindling resources can become a problem with such a mighty enemy in front of us.

source.other: The area beyond the pirates belongs to a developed tribe led by their mighty chieftain Hjalmar. They have had a long time of preparement to build up their deterring armies.

target.other: Området bortom piraterna tillhör en utvecklad stam som leds av den mäktige hövdingen Hjalmar. De har haft lång tid på sig att bygga upp sina avskräckande arméer.

key: The area beyond the pirates belongs to a developed tribe led by their mighty chieftain Hjalmar. They have had a long time of preparement to build up their deterring armies.

source.other: A large area to the north-east is agonized by a wild horde of unfettered pirates, led by their insane Arvid. Their presence blocks our ways to other tribes.

target.other: Ett stort område i nordost plågas av en vild hord av okontrollerade pirater, ledda av den galne Arvid. Deras existens blockerar vår väg till de andra stammarna.

key: A large area to the north-east is agonized by a wild horde of unfettered pirates, led by their insane Arvid. Their presence blocks our ways to other tribes.

source.other: Four shovels for removing the swamps have been collected at the warehouse.

target.other: Fyra spadar för att avlägsna träsken har samlats in i lagerbyggnaden.

key: Four shovels for removing the swamps have been collected at the warehouse.

source.other: Törver is the enemy in the North, who is fighting under the red banner.

target.other: Törver är fienden i norr som strider med rött baner.

key: Törver is the enemy in the North, who is fighting under the red banner.

source.other: In Törver’s headquarters we found papers describing the construction of ships. Unfortunately, the texts are written in a language that is unknown to us. Our wise men will try to translate these descriptions.

target.other: I Törvers högkvarter hittade vi dokument med beskrivningar av skeppsbygge. Oturligt nog är de skrivna på ett för oss oförståeligt språk. Våra vise män ska försöka översätta dessa dokument.

key: In Törver’s headquarters we found papers describing the construction of ships. Unfortunately, the texts are written in a language that is unknown to us. Our wise men will try to translate these descriptions.

source.other: We can then also use their access to the lake in order to explore more land.

target.other: Då kan vi också använda deras tillgång till sjön för att utforska mer mark.

key: We can then also use their access to the lake in order to explore more land.

source.other: Sire, let me inform you about the surrounding tribes.

target.other: Ers höghet, låt mig informera dig om de kringliggande stammarna.

key: Sire, let me inform you about the surrounding tribes.

source.other: We cannot avoid attacking their armies forever. If we manage to conquer our northern enemy, we will enlarge our territory and find more resources to strengthen our armies.

target.other: Vi kan inte undvika att anfalla deras arméer för alltid. Om vi lyckas besegra vår fiende i norr utökar vi vårt territorium och får mer resurser för att stärka våra arméer.

key: We cannot avoid attacking their armies forever. If we manage to conquer our northern enemy, we will enlarge our territory and find more resources to strengthen our armies.

source.other: Defeat Runar

target.other: Besegra Runar

key: Defeat Runar

source.other: Victory!

target.other: Seger!

key: Victory!

source.other: Removing the swamps

target.other: Ta bort träsken

key: Removing the swamps

source.other: Sire, we have almost defeated all armies and we are now approaching our final enemy. They have been expecting us for a long time and will be prepared for the heaviest battle in their lifetime.

target.other: Ers höghet, vi har nästan besegrat alla arméer och närmar oss nu vår sista fiende. De har väntat på oss länge och är beredda på sitt livs hårdaste strid.

key: Sire, we have almost defeated all armies and we are now approaching our final enemy. They have been expecting us for a long time and will be prepared for the heaviest battle in their lifetime.

source.other: Defeat the Armies of Runar

target.other: Besegra Runars arméer

key: Defeat the Armies of Runar

source.other: With our successful expansion into this area we should consider building a warehouse to the direct southwest of the sentry in order to further explore this area. There is a good building spot only three steps away from the sentry.

target.other: Med vår lyckade expansion in i detta område bör vi fundera på att bygga en lagerbyggnad rakt sydväst om vaktposten för att vidare utforska det här området. Det finns en bra byggnadsyta bara tre steg ifrån vaktposten.

key: With our successful expansion into this area we should consider building a warehouse to the direct southwest of the sentry in order to further explore this area. There is a good building spot only three steps away from the sentry.

source.other: Sire, all shovels have been handed out, but if we continue at this pace we will not have removed the swamps before the next wet season. If you bring more shovels to the new warehouse then more volunteers will join in.

target.other: Ers höghet, alla spadar har delats ut, men om vi fortsätter i den här takten hinner vi inte avlägsna träsken före nästa regnperiod. Om du transporterar fler spadar till den nya lagerbyggnaden hjälper fler frivilliga till.

key: Sire, all shovels have been handed out, but if we continue at this pace we will not have removed the swamps before the next wet season. If you bring more shovels to the new warehouse then more volunteers will join in.

source.other: Along the River

target.other: Längs med floden

key: Along the River

source.other: The situation looks quite perilous and my advice is that we direct our efforts towards building up a strong army.

target.other: Situationen ser rätt farlig ut och mitt råd är att vi lägger våra ansträngningar på att bygga upp en stark armé.

key: The situation looks quite perilous and my advice is that we direct our efforts towards building up a strong army.

source.other: Peril from the North

target.other: Fara i norr

key: Peril from the North

source.other: Build a Warehouse near the Pirate Sentry

target.other: Bygg en lagerbyggnad nära piratvaktposten

key: Build a Warehouse near the Pirate Sentry

source.other: The last frontier

target.other: Det sista gränsområdet

key: The last frontier

source.other: Defeat Hjalmar

target.other: Besegra Hjalmar

key: Defeat Hjalmar

source.other: This is where the scout is held captive.

target.other: Spanaren hålls fången här.

key: This is where the scout is held captive.

source.other: The great lake

target.other: Den stora sjön

key: The great lake

source.other: We should however be careful if we want to conquer the sentry. There can be more enemy buildings that are still out of sight, and the pirates are known to be very good fighters. It is best to establish a strong military presence here before we proceed.

target.other: Vi borde vara försiktiga ifall vi vill ta över vaktposten. Det kan finnas fler fientliga byggnader utom synhåll, och piraterna är kända för att vara bra kämpar. Det vore bäst att etablera en stark militär närvaro här innan vi fortsätter.

key: We should however be careful if we want to conquer the sentry. There can be more enemy buildings that are still out of sight, and the pirates are known to be very good fighters. It is best to establish a strong military presence here before we proceed.

source.other: Conquer pirate sentry

target.other: Ta över piraternas vaktpost

key: Conquer pirate sentry

source.other: Runar is the enemy south-east of the former pirates, who is fighting under the yellow banner.

target.other: Runar är fienden sydost om de forna piraterna, som strider under den gula fanan.

key: Runar is the enemy south-east of the former pirates, who is fighting under the yellow banner.

source.other: According to our fishermen he is locked up in the stronghold on the island. We should use the knowledge about shipbuilding that we took from Törver to build ships and attack their positions.

target.other: Enligt våra fiskare är han inlåst i högborgen på ön. Vi bör använda kunskapen om skeppsbygge som vi fick från Törver för att bygga skepp och anfalla deras ställningar.

key: According to our fishermen he is locked up in the stronghold on the island. We should use the knowledge about shipbuilding that we took from Törver to build ships and attack their positions.

source.other: Sire, one of our scouts has been captured by the pirates and brought to their island. He is the only person who knows the way through the swamps towards Hjalmar.

target.other: Ers höghet, en av våra spanare har blivit tillfångatagen av piraterna och tagen till deras ö. Han är den enda som kan vägen genom träsken mot Hjalmar.

key: Sire, one of our scouts has been captured by the pirates and brought to their island. He is the only person who knows the way through the swamps towards Hjalmar.
